description: Verify the third-party kits a local game declares (one with id): each module is read again from its source and must have the sha256 the game declares and its lock froze; its manifest must be what the binary says; the declaration, project.installed, the lock and the kit modules of the game must agree on the version. Answers ok and, per kit, the issues (each says what differs). Run it before an export and after fetching a game. Guide: gripforge_docs { topic: "kit-third-party" }.

game.description: Absolute path of the game: its game.json ({ "project": …, "lock": … }), or the folder that holds it (an exported web game).

id.description: Id of the third-party kit, dotted, as its kit.json says (e.g. acme.streak).

modules.description: Absolute path of a folder of kit modules (kit-modules.json) to check against and to install the module in. Default: <game folder>/runtime-rust/kit-modules, else <game folder>/kit-modules, when present.

name: gripforge_third_party_kit_verify
title: Verify the third-party kits of a game
